newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends at highs despite dull NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends at highs despite dull NY.

text.p: London's August white sugar contract edged higher in late trading on Thursday, dragging further forward positions higher and boosting the already solid turnover.

At the close, August stood $2.70 higher at a high of $323.90 despite the lacklustre activity on the raws market. Volume reached 4,407 lots and was boosted by crosses on spreads and outright positions.
October was up $2.50 at $313.00 and all other contracts were also firmer.

Technically, Thursday's bullish performance has pushed August through a fresh upward trendline dating from a mid-February high of $312.00 and analysts said the position was now targetting $328.00 as nearby resistance.
August was well supported by short-term moving averages and a also band of trading between $310 and $315, they said.
